description: Monthly unemployment rate (seasonally adjusted, % of the labour force aged 15-74) for one European country or the EU / euro area, optionally for men or women only. Answers "what is unemployment in Spain" for job seekers, analysts and reporters. Source: Eurostat dataset une_rt_m (ILO definition, so it can differ from national claimant counts). The newest month is sometimes not yet published for every country. (cost: 1 credit)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent months, 1-100, default 12

sex.description: string, optional: total (default), male or female (T, M, F)

name: eu_unemployment_rate
